The short version. You can play TowerClimber as a guest, without giving us your name or your
email address. Your account is a randomly generated ID. We never see your payment-card details. We show ads, and we ask
our ad provider for non-personalised ads. We do not sell your data.




This policy explains what TowerClimber collects, why, and what you can do about it. It covers the TowerClimber
mobile game on Google Play and the Apple App Store, and this website.



Who we are


TowerClimber is published under the name All Star Studios, which is a trading name of
Matej Samardjiev, an individual developer based in North Macedonia. Matej Samardjiev is the data
controller for the purposes of the GDPR and equivalent laws.


For anything in this policy, contact
support.allstarstudios@gmail.com (mailto:support.allstarstudios@gmail.com).



What we collect



Your account


When the game first connects successfully to our servers, we create a guest account for you automatically.
You can begin playing offline before that connection. That account is a
randomly generated identifier. It is not derived from your device, your phone number, or anything
about you. Alongside it we store the type of account, when it was created, and when it was last used.


The game never asks you for your name or your email address, and our servers do not store either one.



If you sign in with Google


Signing in is optional for gameplay. Linking Google sign-in helps recover synced progress while our services
operate. It is required before purchasing or restoring eligible purchases, so purchases can be tied to your
account and supported if something goes wrong. Unsynced progress may be lost. Signing into a different existing
account switches accounts; it does not automatically merge their progress.


We use Google Sign In to obtain a stable identifier for your Google account, and we store that identifier so we
can recognise you next time. We do not store your Google email address, your name, or your profile picture.



Your game progress


So your progress can follow you across devices, we store your high score and run statistics, your gold and
character token balances, which characters you own, your daily reward streak, and your pack opening history. We also
keep a record of changes to your balances, so that if something goes wrong we can see what happened and put it
right.


The phone also stores local progress, preferences and pending offline actions. Those actions are reconciled
when you reconnect; queue limits, lost local data or rejected transactions can prevent all changes from syncing.
Uninstalling the app or clearing its data may remove local progress, and does not delete your server account.



Purchases


Purchases are handled by the app store you bought from, Google Play or the Apple App Store, through a service
called RevenueCat. Your card details never reach us and we never see them.


RevenueCat processes what it needs to verify a purchase, which may include your TowerClimber account identifier,
device and platform information, the store receipt or purchase token, the product bought, and transaction details and
dates. Our servers store purchase-event notifications from RevenueCat so we can credit your account,
verify entitlements and support purchases. These records may include account identifiers and aliases,
product and transaction references, event dates, prices, currency and country information supplied by the provider.



Advertising


TowerClimber shows ads through Google AdMob. We configure AdMob to request non-personalised ads,
meaning ads are not targeted using a profile of your interests.


Even for non-personalised ads, Google may access your device's advertising identifier and general device and
network information in order to cap how often you see the same ad, to detect fraud, and to report aggregate
performance. That processing is Google's, under
Google's own privacy terms (https://policies.google.com/technologies/partner-sites).


Remove Ads stops automatic full-screen ads (interstitials). You can still voluntarily
choose to watch rewarded ads to receive an offered in-game reward. Buying Remove Ads does not disable all
advertising technology or mean that all ad-related data processing stops. The advertising practices described
here also apply when you choose rewarded ads.


To verify rewarded-ad claims, we share your game account identifier and a reward-verification reference with
Google. We receive verification information to validate and credit the reward.



When you contact us


If you email our support address, we receive whatever you send, including your email address and anything you
choose to put in the message. We keep that correspondence for as long as we need it to deal with your query and to
handle any follow up, then delete it. We do not add it to your game account or use it for marketing.



Technical information


Our servers see your IP address while handling your requests, and use it briefly to limit how often requests can
be made from one place. This is anti abuse only. We do not build a profile from it and do not store it against your
account.



This website


This website is hosted by Netlify. When you visit it, Netlify may process technical request information such as
your IP address, browser and device information, the pages you request and the time of each request, in order to
deliver and secure the site. We do not run analytics on this website, and we do not intentionally set cookies or
store information in your browser.



What we do not collect



Your postal address or phone number.


Your precise location. The game never asks for GPS or location permission. Our providers may infer an
approximate location, such as country or city, from your IP address, for advertising, fraud prevention and
running the service.


Your contacts, photos, files, or calendar.


Microphone or camera access. The game does not request either.


Anything you type in the game, beyond what is needed to run it.




Why we are allowed to hold it


If you are in the UK, EU, or somewhere with comparable law: we process your account and progress data because it
is necessary to provide the game you asked for. We retain purchase and transaction records where
necessary to comply with a legal obligation, and because we have a legitimate interest
in supporting purchases, preventing fraud and resolving disputes. Anti abuse rests on the same legitimate interest in
protecting the game.


For advertising: where the law requires consent, such as in the EEA, the UK and Switzerland, we ask for your
consent before advertising technologies use device identifiers or similar storage, and you can change your choice at
any time. Where consent is not required, advertising rests on our legitimate interest in funding the game.



Who we share it with


We do not sell your data, and we do not share it for anyone else's marketing. We use these providers to run the
game:





ProviderWhat they handle




Railway: Hosts our servers and database:


Netlify: Hosts this website:


RevenueCat: Verifies purchases with the app stores:


Google Play and Apple: Take payment and process the transaction:


Google AdMob: Serves the ads in the game:


Google Sign In: Verifies your identity if you choose to sign in:





Each of these handles your data under its own privacy terms. We may also disclose information where the law
requires it.



Where your data is held


Our primary game servers and database, which hold your TowerClimber account and your game progress, are hosted in
the European Union, in Amsterdam.


Some of the providers listed above are based outside the EU and may process data in the United States or
elsewhere. Where that happens we rely on the transfer safeguards available under applicable law, such as the EU to US
Data Privacy Framework where a provider participates in it, or Standard Contractual Clauses.



Keeping and deleting your data


We retain account and progress data to operate your account while the service is available, unless you
request deletion or another lawful reason requires removal. Stopping play or uninstalling does not itself
trigger account deletion. If a service closes, the discontinuation provisions in our
Terms of Service (https://towerclimber-game.netlify.app/terms.html#shutdown) apply.


To delete your account, open the game and go to Profile › Delete Account.
This requires an internet connection. Once our server successfully processes the request, it removes your
account and the associated game data described below.


You can also email
support.allstarstudios@gmail.com (mailto:support.allstarstudios@gmail.com?subject=Account%20deletion%20request)
with the subject Account deletion request and the Player ID shown on the game's Profile screen.
A Player ID or email address alone is not proof of account ownership; we may need additional verification
before acting. Do not send passwords, sign-in tokens or full payment-card details.
We handle requests within the deadlines required by applicable law.


When you delete your account we permanently delete it and the game data attached to it, including your gold and
token balances, the characters you own, your statistics and high score, your daily reward state and your pack
history. Linked sign-in associations and stored refresh sessions are removed. Deletion does not remotely erase
data on other offline devices, and an already issued access token may remain valid until it expires.
The deleted progress cannot be recovered through purchase restoration.


Deletion removes the account's recorded entitlements, but it does not erase app-store purchase records,
automatically request a refund or remove applicable restoration and consumer rights.
Eligible non-consumables such as Remove Ads may be restored under the conditions in our
Terms of Service (https://towerclimber-game.netlify.app/terms.html#payments). Restoration does not recover deleted progress or replenish
gold already spent. Account deletion does not automatically erase records independently held by our providers.


We keep purchase and transaction records where we need them for tax, accounting, fraud prevention, dispute
resolution or another legal obligation, along with a minimal record that a deletion was carried out. These records
are detached from the deleted account's database entry, but retained purchase notifications and deletion records
can still contain identifiers or transaction references. Detaching them does not make them anonymous.
The app stores hold your payment-card details, not us.



Your rights


Depending on where you live, you may have the right to ask us for a copy of what we hold about you, to correct it,
to delete it, to restrict or object to how we use it, or to complain to your data protection regulator. Email us at
support.allstarstudios@gmail.com (mailto:support.allstarstudios@gmail.com) and we will respond within 30
days.


Because a guest account holds no name or email address, we may need the Player ID shown in the game to identify
the account your request relates to.



Children


The minimum age for using our app is 13, or a higher age required by applicable law, as set out in our
Terms of Service (https://towerclimber-game.netlify.app/terms.html#eligibility). TowerClimber is not directed at children under 13,
and we do not knowingly collect personal information from them.
If you believe a child has given us information, email us and we will delete the account.



Security


All traffic between the game and our servers is encrypted with HTTPS. Sign in tokens are stored in your device's
secure storage, and the tokens we hold on our servers are stored hashed rather than in readable form. No system is
perfectly secure, but we take reasonable steps to protect what we hold, which by design is very little.



Changes to this policy


If we change this policy, we will update its version and date and provide any notice required by law.
Released versions remain archived. The app presents a required updated policy for acknowledgement;
offline devices learn of updates on reconnection, and updates detected during a climb are presented after it ends.
Acknowledging this policy confirms receipt of the notice; it does not replace separate advertising consent
or waive your privacy rights.


We store the policy and Terms versions acknowledged, your account identifier, the recorded acknowledgement
time and the server receipt time. Acknowledgements made offline are stored on the phone and synced when an
account connection is available. These account records are removed with account deletion.



Contact


Matej Samardjiev, trading as All Star Studios

support.allstarstudios@gmail.com (mailto:support.allstarstudios@gmail.com)
